content.text:
Welch Allyn ophthalmology/eye-exam tools are now commonly listed under **Welch Allyn | Hillrom | Baxter**. The main tools you’ll see include:

| Tool | What it’s for | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **PanOptic Plus Ophthalmoscope** | Direct retinal/fundus exam | Wide-view ophthalmoscope; Welch Allyn says it provides a **20× larger viewing area** than a standard 3.5 V ophthalmoscope and can work with the **iExaminer Pro** system for photo/video capture. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **PanOptic Ophthalmoscope** | Fundus exam through undilated pupils | Older/standard PanOptic model; marketed as giving a wider fundus view than conventional direct ophthalmoscopes. ([hillrom.nl](https://www.hillrom.nl/en/products/panoptic-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Standard 3.5 V Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** | Traditional direct ophthalmoscopy | Common in diagnostic sets for medical students, primary care, ED, neurology, etc. |
| **Retinoscope** | Objective refraction | Often sold in ophthalmic diagnostic sets with a 3.5 V handle. |
| **Ophthalmic Sets** | Bundled eye-exam kit | Welch Allyn ophthalmic sets may include the **PanOptic Plus ophthalmoscope**, retinoscope, power handle, charger, and case depending on configuration. ([hillrom.com](https://www.hillrom.com/en/products/ophthalmic-sets/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **iExaminer Pro System / SmartBracket** | Digital image capture | Add-on system that lets compatible PanOptic Plus exams capture photos/video via app. ([hillrom.cn](https://www.hillrom.cn/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Power handles/chargers** | Power source for 3.5 V heads | PanOptic Plus is compatible with Welch Allyn 3.5 V power sources and can pair with a Lithium Ion Plus handle. ([hillrom.cn](https://www.hillrom.cn/en/products/panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Patient eyecups/accessories** | Contact/interface accessory | Used with PanOptic models; replacement eyecups and accessories are commonly available. ([cwimedical.com](https://www.cwimedical.com/ophthalmoscopes/panoptic-ophthalmoscope-accessories-panopt-ac?utm_source=openai)) |

**Quick buying guidance:**
- For **medical students/general physical exam**: a standard Welch Allyn diagnostic set may be enough, but check your school’s requirements before buying.
- For **primary care, neurology, ED, rural/urgent care**: **PanOptic or PanOptic Plus** is often more practical because the fundus view is easier to obtain than with a standard direct ophthalmoscope.
- For **digital documentation/teaching**: choose **PanOptic Plus + iExaminer Pro** compatibility.
- For **optometry/ophthalmology clinics**: Welch Allyn handhelds are useful, but specialists often rely more on slit lamp, BIO, fundus camera/OCT, and lens-based exams.

If you tell me whether you’re looking to **buy**, **identify a tool**, **compare models**, or **find replacement parts**, I can narrow this down.
